title: Native source-conditioned table policy comparison
question: On matched authentic marginal roles, what changes across feasibility, independent weighting, coupling and sensitivity?
method: Independent source judgments and exact executed observations, with separately bounded conclusions.

results.name: Matched retained contributions
results.note: Exact same set in all seven arms.

results.name: Source-supported top selections

results.name: Assessed axes with shared factors
results.note: Three coupled requests have shared factors.

conclusion: All seven registered runs and their ordinary export passed. Both weighted arms selected all nine supported interpretations at every tested scale. Coupling changed probabilities and did not improve top selections. This experiment exercises the producer and does not establish native independent reconstruction of every source-conditioned factor.
